the development of a high performance event building system based on ATM switching technology and with the development of the necessary hardware and software components for its construction.
the development of the hardware, software, and network protocols for an ATM-based event-building architecture.
the development and evaluation of an asynchronous data-driven event building architecture based on ATM switching technology.
